model.rawSql:
SELECT ServiceName AS service, countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') / count() AS error_ratio
FROM otel_traces
WHERE Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND SpanKind IN ('Server', 'Consumer') AND NOT startsWith(ServiceName, 'ws-')
GROUP BY service
HAVING count() >= 50

annotations.description: More than 5% of the server and consumer spans of {{ $labels.service }} ended with an error in the last 10 minutes (at least 50 spans). Workspace router spans have their own rules.

model.rawSql:
SELECT substring(ServiceName, 4) AS workspace, SpanAttributes['server.address'] AS server, countIf(toUInt16OrZero(if(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'] != '', SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'], SpanAttributes['http.status_code'])) >= 500) / count() AS error_ratio
FROM otel_traces
WHERE Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND startsWith(ServiceName, 'ws-')
GROUP BY workspace, server
HAVING count() >= 20

annotations.summary: {{ $labels.server }} in workspace {{ $labels.workspace }} answers {{ humanizePercentage $values.A.Value }} of its requests with 5xx
annotations.description: More than 10% of the requests the workspace router passed to {{ $labels.server }} in the last 5 minutes got a 5xx response (at least 20 requests), for 5 minutes.

model.rawSql:
SELECT substring(ServiceName, 4) AS workspace, SpanAttributes['server.address'] AS server, uniqExact(toStartOfMinute(Timestamp)) AS minutes_down
FROM otel_traces
WHERE Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE AND startsWith(ServiceName, 'ws-') AND toUInt16OrZero(if(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'] != '', SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'], SpanAttributes['http.status_code'])) IN (502, 503, 504)
GROUP BY workspace, server

annotations.summary: {{ $labels.server }} in workspace {{ $labels.workspace }} was unreachable in {{ $values.A.Value }} of the last 30 minutes
annotations.description: The workspace router got no answer from {{ $labels.server }} (502, 503 or 504) in at least 3 separate minutes of the last 30. Usually the server process keeps crashing and restarting, for example when it is OOM-killed; check its memory and logs. Resolves 30 minutes after the last such response.
